description: Energy layers and assessments: Yemen is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency. The UNHCR Energy Monitoring Framework takes a program-based approach to monitoring, with the aim of tracking both outputs and the impact of UNHCR dollars spent on programming (either via partners or through direct implementation). Coverage: Yemen. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency. Its tags are energy, environment, facilities-infrastructure, food security. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, WEB APP. The portal shows 2022-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
